reference_actions.argument_body: {"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m03"],"text":"Each function takes a single JSON value and always returns a plain JSON-safe object; malformed input yields an error object, never an exception."},{"source_ids":["m04"],"text":"Elements that fail normalization are never silently dropped: each is reported as {\"index\": i, \"error\": message} carrying the helper's message and its zero-based position, in arrival order."},{"source_ids":["m01","m04"],"text":"Every submission attempt is preserved; resubmissions of the same assignment by the same student are kept as separate records, never deduplicated or merged."},{"source_ids":["m03","m04"],"text":"Sorting or reordering output records is prohibited; arrival order must be preserved exactly."},{"source_ids":["m03"],"text":"Whenever a feature reports an average, round it to two decimal places."}]}

{"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m03"],"text":"Each function takes a single JSON value and always returns a plain JSON-safe object; malformed input yields an error object, never an exception."},{"source_ids":["m08"],"text":"In group_submissions, invalid entries are still reported: the validator's errors list is carried over into the result unchanged."},{"source_ids":["m01","m04","m08"],"text":"Every submission attempt is preserved; resubmissions of the same assignment by the same student are kept as separate records, never deduplicated or merged."},{"source_ids":["m03","m04","m08"],"text":"Sorting or reordering output records is prohibited; arrival order must be preserved exactly."},{"source_ids":["m07"],"text":"Whenever a feature reports an average, round it to one decimal place; this supersedes the earlier two-decimal instruction."}]}

{"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m03"],"text":"Each function takes a single JSON value and always returns a plain JSON-safe object; malformed input yields an error object, never an exception."},{"source_ids":["m11","m12"],"text":"In summarize_class, the errors list carried over from grouping is unchanged and must always be present in the result, even when empty."},{"source_ids":["m01","m04","m08"],"text":"Every submission attempt is preserved; resubmissions of the same assignment by the same student are kept as separate records, never deduplicated or merged."},{"source_ids":["m03","m04","m08"],"text":"Sorting or reordering output records is prohibited; arrival order must be preserved exactly."},{"source_ids":["m07","m12"],"text":"Whenever a feature reports an average, round it to one decimal place; this supersedes the earlier two-decimal instruction."},{"source_ids":["m11","m12"],"text":"For the class summary only, a student who resubmitted the same assignment counts exactly once, with their best score; their other attempts are excluded from the summary's submissions counts, distinct-student counts, and averages."}]}

{"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m-r0-u1"],"text":"Whenever an input object carries a key the current task does not recognize, it is rejected before any other check, naming the unrecognized key that comes first in alphabetical order, formatted exactly as unexpected key '<name>'."},{"source_ids":["m-r0-u2"],"text":"Unless allow_duplicates is true, processing stops at the first case-insensitive (artist, title) repeat with the error duplicate track <n> naming the 1-based position of the LATER occurrence."},{"source_ids":["m-r0-u2"],"text":"With allow_duplicates true, every validated track is retained in input order, duplicates included."}]}

{"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m-r0-u1"],"text":"Whenever an input object carries a key the current task does not recognize, it is rejected before any other check, naming the unrecognized key that comes first in alphabetical order, formatted exactly as unexpected key '<name>'."},{"source_ids":["m-r1-u1","m-r1-u2"],"text":"The sequencer never validates tracks itself: it calls normalize_tracklist with exactly tracks and (when present) allow_duplicates, returns any failure unchanged, and hands non-object payloads straight through."},{"source_ids":["m-r1-u2"],"text":"'order' is optional with default 'artist'; only 'artist' or 'duration' are accepted, and any other present value returns exactly 'order' must be 'artist' or 'duration'."},{"source_ids":["m-r1-u1","m-r1-u2"],"text":"Tracks that compare equal under the chosen ordering keep their original relative order; the sequencer applies no secondary criterion, so same-artist groups (ignoring case) stay in input order."}]}

{"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m-r0-u1"],"text":"Whenever an input object carries a key the current task does not recognize, it is rejected before any other check, naming the unrecognized key that comes first in alphabetical order, formatted exactly as unexpected key '<name>'."},{"source_ids":["m-r2-u1","m-r2-u3"],"text":"In the manifest's artist ordering, tracks by the same artist (ignoring case) are listed longest-first; equal lengths keep the sequenced relative order; the duration ordering is used exactly as sequenced."},{"source_ids":["m-r2-u3"],"text":"Manifest keys are only tracks, order, allow_duplicates, title, gap_seconds with unrecognized keys rejected before any other check; title is required, a string, non-blank after cleaning, and echoed cleaned; gap_seconds is optional with default 2, must be an integer (booleans excluded) and non-negative, with exact rejection texts."},{"source_ids":["m-r2-u3"],"text":"The manifest delegates sequencing to sequence_playlist with exactly tracks, order (when present) and allow_duplicates (when present), returns any failure unchanged, and hands non-object payloads straight through."},{"source_ids":["m-r2-u3"],"text":"Each manifest entry carries exactly position (1-based in final order), id, title, artist, seconds, clock, start, start_clock, explicit, with clock and start_clock produced by format_clock."},{"source_ids":["m-r2-u2"],"text":"No order modes beyond 'artist' and 'duration' may be introduced anywhere."}]}
